name: OPSD-IT-mp
notes: ENTSO-E IT system load (OPSD time_series 60min, IT_load_actual_entsoe_transparency) + ERA5 weather (Open-Meteo). aux column holds the TSO's own published day-ahead load forecast (IT_load_forecast_entsoe_transparency, coverage 99.9%). exogenous-series rules: (1) a solar/wind series is dropped if its raw data has any single internal gap longer than 720 h (30 d); (2) then dropped if <50% present over the load span (v1). generation columns kept: {'solar': 'IT_solar_generation_actual (max internal gap 9 h)'}. dropped: [wind=IT_wind_onshore_generation_actual (internal gap of 1608 h > 720 h)]. span start trimmed from 2015-01-01 01:00:00 (first load row) to 2015-10-02 06:00:00 (first fully observed row). missing cells interpolated: 16 (per channel {'solar': 16}; linear up to 6 h, then ffill/bfill). MULTI-POINT WEATHER VARIANT (revision 2026-10-19): the four weather channels are the population-weighted mean of ERA5 at 6 metropolitan areas (Milano 4.3M, Roma 4.3M, Napoli 3.1M, Torino 1.7M, Palermo 1.0M, Bologna 1.0M); 0 cells interpolated; every other column identical to OPSD-IT.
